title: A Linear issue comment claims a PR shipped that isn't merged
author: esu-elegba
description: The Linear source's third and final claims-X leg, alongside linear-comment-claims-unfixed-issue (task 600) and linear-comment-claims-open-milestone (task 602) -- that second recipe's own docstring named this exact leg as its own future seam before anyone built it. Extracts every 'ships/includes/merges/via #N' claim phrase (seam_engine.pr_claims' shared grammar, imported verbatim, the seventh recipe to bind to it) from a Linear issue comment's own text and cross-checks it against the live PR tracker's own state -- the identical PR-claim check review-comment-claims-unmerged-pr already runs against a GitHub review comment, applied here to the Linear issue-comment surface linear-comment-claims-unfixed-issue/linear-comment-claims-open-milestone already opened. A PR that exists but is not merged is the seam: a comment already sitting on a Linear issue disagrees with GitHub's own record, and nothing on either platform ever compares them. With this recipe shipped, the claims-X grid (ten sources times three targets) has exactly one genuinely open cell left: slack-message-claims-unmerged-pr. Fixture-only, MOCK ONLY, never a live network call -- the-hand gateway holds a real, connected upstream Linear app but exposes zero Linear-capable tools on its live toolset today, same WIP note both of this recipe's own Linear siblings already carry. Neither scope is new (SearchIssueComments and ListPullRequests are both already registered) and linear+github is not a new toolkit pair (both Linear siblings already proposed it).
confidence_notes: Age-gated by hours since the comment's own created_at, holding linear-comment-claims-open-milestone's own 0.85/0.5 bar exactly -- NOT review-comment-claims-unmerged-pr's lower 0.55/0.85 bar for an editable surface. A Linear issue comment is posted once and stands, exactly as durable and readable-later as a Slack channel message, a tweet, or a mention once posted -- mention-claims-unmerged-pr's/tweet-claims-unmerged-pr's/linear-comment-claims-open-milestone's identical bar applies, not review-comment-claims-unmerged-pr's bar, which exists because a review comment can be edited after posting; a Linear issue comment cannot be un-said the same way. A claim checked within 24 hours of posting might still be a race (the PR actually merging moments after the comment went out) rather than a settled public overclaim (0.5, below the 0.70 confidence bar, shown as a weighed-and-dropped coincidence, not hidden). At or past 24 hours with the named PR still unmerged, it is unambiguous (flat 0.85). The check itself is objective: the claimed PR's own live merged/state fields, verified against ListPullRequests, not a guess about which tracker the commenter meant. A named PR that does not exist at all is excluded at confidence 0.0, named not hidden -- a broken reference is a future Linear-side dangling-reference recipe's own seam, not this one's. A named PR that IS merged is excluded too -- the claim was simply true. A comment with no ships/includes/merges/via claim phrase at all produces no candidate. No text in this recipe's own headline/detail strings ever names or grades the Linear commenter -- CONTRIBUTING.md's 'No grading, ever' law, same as every recipe in this engine.
